name: netatlas
description: Offline, single-file network architecture diagram tool (YAML in, interactive SVG out)

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-examples.mjs && node scripts/gen-help.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/gen-support.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.check:dist: node scripts/gen-examples.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-help.mjs --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/make-fixtures.mjs --check && node scripts/gen-support.mjs --check && node scripts/build.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests.mjs all
